properties.name: HC-VL-PQK-01
properties.notes: HC-VL-PQK-01, commonly called the Point Golqik Horizon Station, is a primary coastal station built on the higher ground above the settlement. Its compound consists of a low concrete timing house, a guyed transmission mast, a power shed, fuel store, and a small bunkhouse for rotating technicians. Though modest in size, it is one of the most important northern Veluan stations, extending reliable Horizon Chain coverage along a coast where ordinary landmarks are sparse and weather frequently obscures the sea.
